system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The MetaAgent then switches to Manager mode by using a new prompt consisting of in-context documents for these selected agents
system_prompt_style.note: Manager prompt assembled from documents of the top-K selected agents; paper only.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: MetaAgent combines the task description with the system state (including screenshots, terminal output, accessibility tree, etc.) to select the appropriate agents
env_context_strategy.note: The system state is injected up front, and the sub-agents also act in the environment. Neither value fits cleanly.

observation_format.evidence_quote: system state (including screenshots, terminal output, accessibility tree, etc.)

tool_call_format.note: Agent routing is done by predicting a special agent token. The sub-agents emit pyautogui-style calls, shell commands, and Python code.

tool_count.note: The pool has over 20 agents; no tool count is reported.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: the developer completes a predefined form outlining the agent’s capabilities, limitations, applications it interacts with, and demonstrations of its functionality
tool_schema_source.note: Agent documents are written by hand; agents are also encoded as learned tokens.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: we established an agent integration protocol
protocol_standardization.note: This is a proprietary AgentEnroll protocol, not a published one, so 'none' may fit better.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
Once an agent token is predicted,i.e.,t∗
i∈A , the MetaAgent halts decoding, and the corresponding
agent is invoked to execute the task.
loop_primitives.note: The run is route-then-execute. The sub-agents' own loops are inferred.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: MetaAgent divides the task into subtasks and assigns each to the appropriate agents

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the MetaAgent selects the most suitable agent(s) from AgentPool to independently or collaboratively complete tasks

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
the corresponding
agent is invoked to execute the task
delegation_mechanism.note: Figure 2 labels this 'message passing'. It could equally be coded as role_handoff.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the selection for the router and manager mode can be either manual or automatic
human_in_loop.note: The human can choose the mode manually; that is the only human gate described.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The AgentPool is a collection of all available agents within AgentStore.
long_term_memory.note: The pool of enrolled agents is treated as a library of skills.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: MetaAgent acts as a router, choosing the most suitable agent when a single agent can handle the task
cost_controls.note: Routing is chosen by capability, not cost.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
OSWorld (Xie et al., 2024) provides a scalable and real environment for evaluating
computer agents
execution_isolation.note: The VM is inferred from the OSWorld benchmark environment.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on OSWorld and APPAgent; no repo is available to verify built-in evaluation.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
a scalable platform designed to dynamically
integrate heterogeneous agents for automating computer tasks
target_domain.note: Mobile OS and web agents are also included in the pool.

open_source.evidence_quote: All our codes will be made publicly available
open_source.note: The paper promises a code release, but no licence is given.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
These agents range from unimodal to multimodal, from open-source to closed-
source models
model_agnostic.note: The MetaAgent itself is InternVL2-8B with trained tokens.
